variants.baseline_behavior: Products starts in English with lang=en, switching to Spanish updates both content and lang to es, and switching back to English restores both content and lang to en.
variants.validation_approach: Run the Checkout co-sem-137 focused acquisition through correct English CO-S001 and Spanish CO-S007 states, activate English, inspect the final English CO-S020 page-language evidence, build lang-mismatch candidates, and require English content with the stale Spanish root declaration. Initial English, intermediate Spanish, clean final English, co-sem-015, and co-sem-130 controls must not recover.

variants.why_semantic: The Help page declares German while its substantive policy, preparation, and clinic-arrival content remains English, so the page language declaration conflicts with the visible page language.
variants.seeded_behavior: Directly open Help with all English content, title, headings, links, and behavior unchanged while declaring the document root language as German.
variants.baseline_behavior: Help declares document language en and presents substantive English policy and instructional content.
variants.validation_approach: Run equivalent clean and booking-bs-sem-159 focused acquisitions by directly opening Help, verify only the root lang changes from en to de while all English content, title, headings, links, local language metadata, navigation, and behavior remain unchanged, inspect page-language evidence, build lang-mismatch candidates, and recover only the seeded Help candidate through its declared root language, English page signal, route, title, and initial state.
